definitions.explanation: The act of preparing and cooking food.

examples.japanese: {炊事|すいじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Cooking and laundry are daily chores.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊事場|すいじば}→炊事場：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備：01431_junbi⟧。
examples.english: I prepared the meal in the kitchen.

notes:
{炊事|すいじ} refers to cooking or food preparation as a household chore or task.

Common collocations:
- {炊事|すいじ}{洗濯|せんたく} (cooking and laundry - household chores)
- {炊事場|すいじば} (kitchen, cooking area)
- {炊事|すいじ}{当番|とうばん} (cooking duty)
- {炊事|すいじ}する (to cook, to do the cooking)

Similar words:
- {料理|りょうり} (cooking - more commonly used)
- {調理|ちょうり} (food preparation - more technical)
- {台所|だいどころ}仕事 (kitchen work)

Usage: {炊事|すいじ} is a somewhat formal or traditional term. In everyday conversation, {料理|りょうり} is more common.
